title: Round-off charge is configured as 'Less' (posts every rounded bill on the wrong side)
why: HQ treats the last charge of a rounding transaction type's charge set as the round-off row and writes the signed difference into it (FrmInwards.cs:35228-35243). Posting then uses the charge type's Add/Less flag (FrmInwards.cs:39340-39456): an 'Add' charge posts +v as debit on purchases and credit on sales (correct), a 'Less' charge does the opposite. The party/cash side always gets the rounded bill amount, so with 'Less' each rounded bill's ledger is off by 2 x round-off and the Round off account accumulates the wrong sign. HQ's own 'RoundOff' charge type (9) is also ChTp_Op=0, so it must not be used either; type 5 'Add' is what MP's Round Off uses.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Charge '+CAST(c.Chrg_Id AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name)+' is the round-off row of a rounding charge set but its charge type '+RTRIM(t.Chtp_Name)+' is a Less type (ChTp_Op=0)' Finding, c.Chrg_Id, c.Act_ID Act_Id
FROM IQCHARGES c JOIN IQCHRG_TYPES t ON t.ChTp_ID=c.Chrg_Type
WHERE ISNULL(t.ChTp_Op,0)=0 AND c.Chrg_Id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cs.chrg_Id FROM IQCHRGSETS cs JOIN IQCHRGSETMST m ON m.Set_no=cs.Set_No JOIN TTypes tt ON tt.vousetno=cs.Set_No AND ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)>0
WHERE cs.Grd_Indx=(SELECT MAX(y.Grd_Indx) FROM IQCHRGSETS y WHERE y.Set_No=cs.Set_No))
fixSql:
UPDATE c SET Chrg_Type=5, IsPFChrg=ISNULL(c.IsPFChrg,0), Ent_Date=CAST(CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AS datetime), Ent_Uid=1
FROM IQCHARGES c JOIN IQCHRG_TYPES t ON t.ChTp_ID=c.Chrg_Type
WHERE ISNULL(t.ChTp_Op,0)=0 AND c.Chrg_Id IN (SELECT DISTINCT cs.chrg_Id FROM IQCHRGSETS cs JOIN IQCHRGSETMST m ON m.Set_no=cs.Set_No JOIN TTypes tt ON tt.vousetno=cs.Set_No AND ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)>0
WHERE cs.Grd_Indx=(SELECT MAX(y.Grd_Indx) FROM IQCHRGSETS y WHERE y.Set_No=cs.Set_No))
advice: Same row HQ's charge master writes when the operator changes 'Charge Type' to Add and saves (frmCharges.cs:1477 -> IQCHARGES_insert UPDATE branch: all columns re-sent unchanged, Ent_Date=today, Ent_Uid=user, IsPFChrg from checkbox). FUTURE bills only: already-posted bills keep the wrong side until re-posted (CFG-02/CFG-03). Side effect to know: an old bill re-opened and re-saved in HQ after this change is re-posted with the Add rule, i.e. corrected. mk-hq's engine reads ChTp_Op live (FirmProfile.cs ChargeRow.IsAdd), so parity holds automatically; update the hq-ledger-quirks note afterwards. Verified in a rolled-back transaction on MKHQ_AUDIT_MBM/MP: detect count 1/0 -> 0/0 after fixSql.

title: Bills from 1 Oct 2026 with round-off posted on the wrong side
why: Consequence of CFG-01 on bills not yet covered by filed GST returns. Each bill's IQDayBook is unbalanced by 2 x round-off and the Round off account is misstated. Round-off does not enter taxable value or tax, so GST returns are unaffected either way.
detectSql:
SELECT f.Finding, f.Doc_Id, f.Act_Id FROM (SELECT 'Bill '+RTRIM(ro.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(ro.TNo AS varchar(12))+' of '+CONVERT(varchar(10),ro.Doc_Date,103)+': round-off '+CAST(CAST(ro.Amount AS decimal(9,2)) AS varchar(12))+' posted on the wrong side of account '+CAST(ro.Act_ID AS varchar(12))+' (ledger off by '+CAST(CAST(2*ABS(ro.Amount) AS decimal(9,2)) AS varchar(12))+')' Finding,
  ro.Doc_Id, ro.Act_ID Act_Id, ro.Doc_Date
FROM (SELECT h.Doc_Id, h.Doc_Date, h.TSeries, h.TNo, tt.Vouchtype, dc.Chrg_id, dc.Act_ID, dc.Amount,
  CASE WHEN tt.Vouchtype='Purchase' THEN dc.Amount ELSE -dc.Amount END correct_dr, p.posted_dr
FROM IQDoc_Header h JOIN TTypes tt ON tt.TT_ID=h.Tt_Id
JOIN IQDoc_Chrgs dc ON dc.Doc_id=h.Doc_Id AND dc.CIndx=(SELECT MAX(x.CIndx) FROM IQDoc_Chrgs x WHERE x.Doc_id=h.Doc_Id)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END) posted_dr FROM IQDayBook d WHERE d.Doc_ID=h.Doc_Id AND d.Act_ID=dc.Act_ID) p
WHERE tt.Vouchtype IN ('Purchase','Sales') AND ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)>0 AND dc.Amount<>0) ro WHERE SIGN(ro.posted_dr)=-SIGN(ro.correct_dr) AND ABS(ro.posted_dr)=ABS(ro.Amount)) f WHERE f.Doc_Date>='2026-10-01'
fixSql:
UPDATE d SET TYPE=CASE d.TYPE WHEN 'D' THEN 'C' WHEN 'C' THEN 'D' WHEN 'P' THEN 'R' WHEN 'R' THEN 'P' END
FROM IQDayBook d JOIN (SELECT 'Bill '+RTRIM(ro.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(ro.TNo AS varchar(12))+' of '+CONVERT(varchar(10),ro.Doc_Date,103)+': round-off '+CAST(CAST(ro.Amount AS decimal(9,2)) AS varchar(12))+' posted on the wrong side of account '+CAST(ro.Act_ID AS varchar(12))+' (ledger off by '+CAST(CAST(2*ABS(ro.Amount) AS decimal(9,2)) AS varchar(12))+')' Finding,
  ro.Doc_Id, ro.Act_ID Act_Id, ro.Doc_Date
FROM (SELECT h.Doc_Id, h.Doc_Date, h.TSeries, h.TNo, tt.Vouchtype, dc.Chrg_id, dc.Act_ID, dc.Amount,
  CASE WHEN tt.Vouchtype='Purchase' THEN dc.Amount ELSE -dc.Amount END correct_dr, p.posted_dr
FROM IQDoc_Header h JOIN TTypes tt ON tt.TT_ID=h.Tt_Id
JOIN IQDoc_Chrgs dc ON dc.Doc_id=h.Doc_Id AND dc.CIndx=(SELECT MAX(x.CIndx) FROM IQDoc_Chrgs x WHERE x.Doc_id=h.Doc_Id)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END) posted_dr FROM IQDayBook d WHERE d.Doc_ID=h.Doc_Id AND d.Act_ID=dc.Act_ID) p
WHERE tt.Vouchtype IN ('Purchase','Sales') AND ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)>0 AND dc.Amount<>0) ro WHERE SIGN(ro.posted_dr)=-SIGN(ro.correct_dr) AND ABS(ro.posted_dr)=ABS(ro.Amount)) f ON f.Doc_Id=d.Doc_ID AND f.Act_Id=d.Act_ID
WHERE f.Doc_Date>='2026-10-01'
advice: Run only after CFG-01, otherwise a later HQ re-save re-posts the old (wrong) side. Flipping D<->C / P<->R on the bill's round-off row gives exactly the row HQ writes for an 'Add' round-off: same Act_ID, Contra_ID, amount and narration, opposite side (FrmInwards.cs:39354-39378 inward, 39441-39451 outward); HQ nets per (Act_ID,Contra_ID) and only round-off posts to that account, so no other row changes. The Round off ledger balance changes; nothing else (no tax, stock or party amount). Verified in a rolled-back transaction on MKHQ_AUDIT_MBM/MP: detect count 54/0 -> 0/0 after fixSql.

title: Bill ledger rows posted to an account that does not exist
why: A charge pointing at a deleted account still posts (HQ only checks Act_ID>0, FrmInwards.cs:39352/39397). The rows sit in IQDayBook under an id with no IQAccmst row, so they vanish from every ledger, trial balance and P&L while the bill itself is unbalanced in reports. In MP this is the Round Off charge (73 -> 424) on purchase bills.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Bill '+RTRIM(ISNULL(h.TSeries,d.Tseries))+'/'+CAST(ISNULL(h.TNo,d.Tno) AS varchar(12))+' of '+CONVERT(varchar(10),d.TRDATE,103)+': '+CAST(d.AMOUNT AS varchar(20))+' '+d.TYPE+' posted to missing account '+CAST(d.Act_ID AS varchar(12)) Finding, d.Doc_ID Doc_Id, d.Act_ID Act_Id
FROM IQDayBook d LEFT JOIN IQDoc_Header h ON h.Doc_Id=d.Doc_ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_Id=d.Act_ID)
advice: Owner question (MP): 'Round-off on 58 purchase bills (16 Apr - 22 Oct 2026, net Rs -2.39) was posted to account no. 424, which was deleted. Move those lines to ROUND OFF (10119)?' Most bills are before 1 Oct 2026. The repointing is what HQ itself would write if the charge had the right account and the bill were re-saved (re-save reloads Act_ID from IQDoc_Chrgs, FillCharges_Trans, so IQDoc_Chrgs must be repointed too). User_IQDoc_Chrgs audit copies are history and are left as they are.

title: Charge in a live charge set points to a missing, group or inactive account
why: Charges of a set referenced by a transaction type appear on every bill of that type; any non-zero value is posted to the charge's Act_ID even if that account does not exist (see CFG-04). Today the amounts are zero except MP Round Off, but one keystroke in the Cash Discount / Adjustment column would post to a phantom account.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Charge '+CAST(c.Chrg_Id AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name)+' (in set '+sets.list+') posts to account '+CAST(c.Act_ID AS varchar(12))+CASE WHEN a.Act_Id IS NULL THEN ' which does not exist' WHEN a.Act_Cat<>'A' THEN ' which is a group' ELSE ' which is inactive' END Finding, c.Chrg_Id, c.Act_ID Act_Id
FROM IQCHARGES c LEFT JOIN IQAccmst a ON a.Act_Id=c.Act_ID
CROSS APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(s.Set_No AS varchar(10)),',') list FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cs.chrg_Id, cs.Set_No FROM IQCHRGSETS cs JOIN IQCHRGSETMST m ON m.Set_no=cs.Set_No WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TTypes tt WHERE tt.vousetno=cs.Set_No)) s WHERE s.chrg_Id=c.Chrg_Id) sets
WHERE sets.list IS NOT NULL AND (a.Act_Id IS NULL OR a.Act_Cat<>'A' OR ISNULL(a.Act_Usage,0)<>0)
fixSql:
-- per charge, after the owner chooses the account (@chrg, @act):
UPDATE IQCHARGES SET Act_ID=@act, IsPFChrg=ISNULL(IsPFChrg,0), Ent_Date=CAST(CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AS datetime), Ent_Uid=1 WHERE Chrg_Id=@chrg
advice: Owner question per charge, e.g. MP: 'Round Off (73) -> ROUND OFF 10119? Cash Discount (108) -> DISCOUNT 10116 or Discount A/c 10107? Adjustment (111, both firms) -> which account, or remove Adjustment from the purchase charge set?' FUTURE bills only (and re-saved bills). JobCard set 26 (Engine Oil/Service Tax/Service Charge) is attached to the unused 'Job Card Done' type; pointing its charges or detaching the set is equally fine.

title: Unused legacy charge heads point to missing or group accounts
why: Charges not in any charge set used by a transaction type cannot reach a bill unless someone adds them to a set; harmless today but a trap when the charge master is reorganised.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Charge '+CAST(c.Chrg_Id AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name)+' posts to account '+CAST(c.Act_ID AS varchar(12))+CASE WHEN a.Act_Id IS NULL THEN ' (missing)' WHEN a.Act_Cat<>'A' THEN ' (a group)' ELSE ' (inactive)' END Finding, c.Chrg_Id, c.Act_ID Act_Id
FROM IQCHARGES c LEFT JOIN IQAccmst a ON a.Act_Id=c.Act_ID
WHERE (a.Act_Id IS NULL OR a.Act_Cat<>'A' OR ISNULL(a.Act_Usage,0)<>0) AND c.Chrg_Id NOT IN (SELECT s.chrg_Id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cs.chrg_Id, cs.Set_No FROM IQCHRGSETS cs JOIN IQCHRGSETMST m ON m.Set_no=cs.Set_No WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TTypes tt WHERE tt.vousetno=cs.Set_No)) s)
advice: Leave as is (HQ 2015-16 era heads: PROJ.DISC, DLR.DISC, PKGING, CST, add1-3, disc1-3...). Fix only if a charge is put back into use.

title: Charge sets and charges left behind by the old mk-core prototype
why: The TypeScript prototype created 'MK Core Verified sale/purchase' charge sets and 'MK Core Round ...' charges on 19 Oct 2026. No transaction type uses the sets, but they show in HQ's charge-set picker and in mk-hq's FirmProfile. MBM charge 136 is on 37 purchase bills and MP charge 131 on 1 bill, so those two charges must stay (HQ reloads a bill's charges from IQDoc_Chrgs).
detectSql:
SELECT 'Prototype charge set '+CAST(m.Set_no AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(m.Set_name)+' is not used by any transaction type' Finding, CAST(NULL AS int) Chrg_Id
FROM IQCHRGSETMST m WHERE m.Set_name LIKE 'MK Core%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TTypes tt WHERE tt.vousetno=m.Set_no)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Prototype charge '+CAST(c.Chrg_Id AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name)+' is on no bill', c.Chrg_Id
FROM IQCHARGES c WHERE c.Chrg_Name LIKE 'MK Core%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IQDoc_Chrgs dc WHERE dc.Chrg_id=c.Chrg_Id)
advice: Mirrors HQ's own deletes: charge-set screen refuses only when a TType uses the set, then deletes IQCHRGSETS and IQCHRGSETMST (frmChargeSets.cs:1712-1725); charge delete = proc Charges_Delete (refuses if the charge is in a set or on a bill). Afterwards MBM keeps charge 136 and MP charge 131 (on bills; correct Add type, MBM account 11134, MP account 10119). No bill is touched. Verified in a rolled-back transaction on MKHQ_AUDIT_MBM/MP: detect count 3/1 -> 0/0 after fixSql.

title: Charge-set rows without a charge-set master
why: IQCHRGSETS set 0 (Freight) has no IQCHRGSETMST row. FillCharges_Trans inner-joins the master, so the rows never load: transaction types with vousetno=0 get no charges at all. Inert, but it hides the fact that those types cannot round (CFG-09).
detectSql:
SELECT 'IQCHRGSETS set '+CAST(cs.Set_No AS varchar(10))+' row for charge '+CAST(cs.chrg_Id AS varchar(10))+' has no IQCHRGSETMST master' Finding, cs.chrg_Id Chrg_Id
FROM IQCHRGSETS cs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IQCHRGSETMST m WHERE m.Set_no=cs.Set_No)
advice: Leave: HQ's screens cannot reach set 0 and nothing reads it.

title: Transaction type asks for rounding but its charge set cannot carry the round-off
why: HQ rounds only when the charge grid has rows (FrmInwards.cs:35228) and writes the difference into the LAST row (35239-35243). With no loadable set the RoundedOffTo setting is silently ignored; with a non-round-off last row (e.g. Freight) the round-off would be posted to that charge's account.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Transaction type '+CAST(tt.TT_ID AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(tt.ttype)+' rounds to '+CAST(tt.RoundedOffTo AS varchar(12))+' but '+CASE WHEN lc.chrg_Id IS NULL THEN 'charge set '+CAST(ISNULL(tt.vousetno,0) AS varchar(10))+' loads no charges, so no rounding happens' ELSE 'the last charge of set '+CAST(tt.vousetno AS varchar(10))+' is '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name) END Finding
FROM TTypes tt
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 cs.chrg_Id FROM IQCHRGSETS cs JOIN IQCHRGSETMST m ON m.Set_no=cs.Set_No WHERE cs.Set_No=tt.vousetno ORDER BY cs.Grd_Indx DESC) lc
LEFT JOIN IQCHARGES c ON c.Chrg_Id=lc.chrg_Id
WHERE ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)>0 AND (lc.chrg_Id IS NULL OR (c.Chrg_Name NOT LIKE '%round%' AND c.Chrg_Type<>9))
advice: Only unused types are affected today (MBM 247 Point-To-Point Transfer, MP 245 Stock Transfer Receipt). Report; fix in HQ's transaction-type screen if those types are ever used.

title: Sales type does not round, and its bills carry paise
why: A sales type with RoundedOffTo=0 bills exact paise amounts while the other firm/type rounds to the rupee; cash bills with paise are awkward at the counter and differ from the printed habit.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Transaction type '+CAST(tt.TT_ID AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(tt.ttype)+' has no rounding (RoundedOffTo=0); '+CAST(b.paise AS varchar(10))+' of '+CAST(b.n AS varchar(10))+' bills carry paise' Finding
FROM TTypes tt CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN h.Bill_Amt<>ROUND(h.Bill_Amt,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) paise FROM IQDoc_Header h WHERE h.Tt_Id=tt.TT_ID) b
WHERE tt.Vouchtype='Sales' AND ISNULL(tt.Tt_Status,0)=0 AND ISNULL(tt.RoundedOffTo,0)=0 AND b.paise>0
fixSql:
-- after owner approval, per type (@tt): same as HQ's transaction-type screen 'Rounded off to 1.00'
UPDATE TTypes SET RoundedOffTo=1.00, RoundedOffType=0 WHERE TT_ID=@tt
advice: Owner question: 'MP GST Sales (and MBM IGST Sales) bills are not rounded to the rupee (96 of 139 MP sales bills have paise). Round them like MBM GST Sales?' FUTURE bills only; requires the set's last charge to be an Add-type Round Off with a real account (MP: CFG-05 first).

title: Bank voucher types have no valid default bank account
why: Bank Receipts/Payments (Trmode=1) preselect TTypes.Bank_naccno (FrmFin_Vouchers.cs:3051/3958). It is 387, which does not exist, so every bank voucher starts with no bank and the operator must pick one; a wrong pick goes unnoticed.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Transaction type '+CAST(tt.TT_ID AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(tt.ttype)+' default bank '+CAST(ISNULL(tt.Bank_naccno,0) AS varchar(12))+CASE WHEN a.Act_Id IS NULL THEN ' does not exist' ELSE ' is not an active Bank account' END Finding, tt.Bank_naccno Act_Id
FROM TTypes tt LEFT JOIN IQAccmst a ON a.Act_Id=tt.Bank_naccno
WHERE tt.Vouchtype IN ('Receipts','Payments') AND tt.Trmode=1 AND (a.Act_Id IS NULL OR a.Act_Type<>'Bank' OR a.Act_Cat<>'A' OR ISNULL(a.Act_Usage,0)<>0)
fixSql: UPDATE TTypes SET Bank_naccno=@bank WHERE TT_ID IN (205,207)
advice: Owner question: 'Which bank should Bank Receipts / Bank Payments open with? (MBM: KARUR VYSYABANK 890 10701 is the bank actually used on bills; MP: THE KARUR YSYABANK 10210 or G PAY 10238)'. Affects data entry defaults only, no posted voucher.

title: Legacy account columns of transaction types point to missing accounts
why: TTypes still carry VAT-era columns (Exempt/Gross4/Gross145/Gross1/Tax4/Tax145/Tax1/CashDisc/Freight/CrDrNote/Roundoff_ActID) and default Bank/Sub accounts copied from an old template (387, 587, 404-675...). FrmInwards loads them (FrmInwards.cs:30232-30242) but GST posting never reads them, so they are inert.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Transaction type '+CAST(tt.TT_ID AS varchar(10))+' '+RTRIM(tt.ttype)+' column '+v.col+' = '+CAST(v.a AS varchar(12))+' (missing account)' Finding, v.a Act_Id
FROM TTypes tt CROSS APPLY (VALUES ('Cash_naccno',tt.Cash_naccno),('Bank_naccno',tt.Bank_naccno),('Sub_naccno',tt.Sub_naccno),('Exempt_ActID',tt.Exempt_ActID),('Gross4_ActID',tt.Gross4_ActID),('Gross145_ActID',tt.Gross145_ActID),('Gross1_ActID',tt.Gross1_ActID),('Tax4_ActID',tt.Tax4_ActID),('Tax145_ActID',tt.Tax145_ActID),('Tax1_ActID',tt.Tax1_ActID),('CashDisc_ActID',tt.CashDisc_ActID),('Freight_ActID',tt.Freight_ActID),('CrDrNote_ActID',tt.CrDrNote_ActID),('Roundoff_ActID',tt.Roundoff_ActID)) v(col,a)
WHERE ISNULL(v.a,0)>1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_Id=v.a)
  AND NOT (v.col='Bank_naccno' AND tt.Vouchtype IN ('Receipts','Payments') AND tt.Trmode=1)
advice: Leave (inert). Bank voucher defaults are CFG-11.

title: Items missing their Ttype_Acnt row for a current transaction type
why: HQ writes one Ttype_Acnt row per item per TTypes row of the 8 item voucher types (FrmItems.cs Fill_GridVAT_Accounts :10754). Items saved before Transfer In/Out types existed lack those rows; a stock transfer of such an item would find no account. HQ adds them the next time the item is saved.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Item '+CAST(e.Item_ID AS varchar(10))+' has no Ttype_Acnt row for transaction type '+CAST(e.TT_ID AS varchar(10))+' ('+e.Vouchtype+')' Finding, e.Item_ID Item_ID, e.exp_act Act_Id
FROM (SELECT i.Item_ID, x.TT_ID, x.Vouchtype, i.VAT, e.lbl, ea.Act_Id exp_act
FROM IQItems_Mast i CROSS JOIN TTypes x
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.lbl FROM (VALUES (CAST(3 AS numeric(9,2)),'3','1.5'),(5,'5','2.5'),(12,'12','6'),(18,'18','9'),(28,'28','14'),(0.1,'0.10','0.05'),(40,'40','20')) r(rate,lbl,half) WHERE r.rate=i.VAT) rr
CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN rr.lbl IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN x.Vouchtype IN ('Purchase','Purchase Return','Purchase Order','Transfer In') THEN N'Purchase '+NCHAR(8211)+N' Exempted' ELSE N'Sales '+NCHAR(8211)+N' Exempt' END
  ELSE CASE WHEN ISNULL(x.Firstor,0)=0 THEN N'IGST ' ELSE N'GST ' END + CASE WHEN x.Vouchtype IN ('Purchase','Purchase Return','Purchase Order','Transfer In') THEN N'Purchase ' ELSE N'Sales ' END + rr.lbl + N'%' END lbl) e
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 a.Act_Id FROM IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_TT=e.lbl ORDER BY a.Act_Id DESC) ea
WHERE x.Vouchtype IN ('Purchase','Sales','Purchase Return','Sales Return','Purchase Order','Sales Order','Transfer In','Transfer Out')) e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Ttype_Acnt t WHERE t.Ic_Id=e.Item_ID AND t.TT_ID=e.TT_ID)
fixSql:
INSERT INTO Ttype_Acnt (Ic_Id, TT_ID, Act_ID, Set_NO, Ent_Date, Ent_Uid)
SELECT e.Item_ID, e.TT_ID, e.exp_act, 0, CAST(CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AS datetime), 1
FROM (SELECT i.Item_ID, x.TT_ID, x.Vouchtype, i.VAT, e.lbl, ea.Act_Id exp_act
FROM IQItems_Mast i CROSS JOIN TTypes x

title: Item GST rate fields or tax-account columns inconsistent with the item's GST %
why: IQItems_Mast.VIP_ID/VOP_ID (IGST input/output) and CGST/SGST input/output ids decide where each bill line's tax is posted; CGST/SGST/IGST must be VAT/2, VAT/2, VAT. A mismatch posts tax to the wrong rate head.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Item '+CAST(i.Item_ID AS varchar(10))+' ('+CAST(i.VAT AS varchar(10))+'%): '+c.col+' = '+CAST(ISNULL(c.cur,0) AS varchar(12))+', HQ rule gives '+CAST(ISNULL(ea.Act_Id,0) AS varchar(12)) Finding, i.Item_ID Item_ID, c.cur Act_Id
FROM IQItems_Mast i
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.lbl, r.half FROM (VALUES (CAST(3 AS numeric(9,2)),'3','1.5'),(5,'5','2.5'),(12,'12','6'),(18,'18','9'),(28,'28','14'),(0.1,'0.10','0.05'),(40,'40','20')) r(rate,lbl,half) WHERE r.rate=i.VAT) rr
CROSS APPLY (VALUES ('VIP_ID',i.VIP_ID,'IGST Input '+rr.lbl+'%'),('VOP_ID',i.VOP_ID,'IGST Output '+rr.lbl+'%'),('CGSTVIP_ID',i.CGSTVIP_ID,'CGST Input '+rr.half+'%'),('CGSTVOP_ID',i.CGSTVOP_ID,'CGST Output '+rr.half+'%'),('SGSTVIP_ID',i.SGSTVIP_ID,'SGST Input '+rr.half+'%'),('SGSTVOP_ID',i.SGSTVOP_ID,'SGST Output '+rr.half+'%')) c(col,cur,lbl)
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 a.Act_Id FROM IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_TT=c.lbl ORDER BY a.Act_Id DESC) ea

UPDATE i SET VIP_ID=ISNULL(x.vip,0), VOP_ID=ISNULL(x.vop,0), CGSTVIP_ID=ISNULL(x.cvip,0), CGSTVOP_ID=ISNULL(x.cvop,0), SGSTVIP_ID=ISNULL(x.svip,0), SGSTVOP_ID=ISNULL(x.svop,0), CGST=i.VAT/2, SGST=i.VAT/2, IGST=i.VAT
FROM IQItems_Mast i
OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.lbl, r.half FROM (VALUES (CAST(3 AS numeric(9,2)),'3','1.5'),(5,'5','2.5'),(12,'12','6'),(18,'18','9'),(28,'28','14'),(0.1,'0.10','0.05'),(40,'40','20')) r(rate,lbl,half) WHERE r.rate=i.VAT) rr

title: GST rate account set incomplete, duplicated or unpostable
why: Set_GSTAccounts looks up 10 labels per rate (GST/IGST Purchase/Sales r%, IGST Input/Output r%, CGST/SGST Input/Output r/2%) by IQAccmst.Act_TT, taking the highest Act_Id; a missing label gives account 0 and HQ refuses to save the item (IsEmptyFound needs VIP/VOP>0), a duplicate silently picks the newer account, a group/inactive one cannot be posted.
detectSql:
SELECT 'GST rate '+r.lbl+'%: label '+l.lbl+CASE WHEN n.cnt=0 THEN ' has no account' WHEN n.cnt>1 THEN ' is on '+CAST(n.cnt AS varchar(5))+' accounts' ELSE ' account is a group or inactive' END Finding, n.maxid Act_Id
FROM (VALUES (CAST(3 AS numeric(9,2)),'3','1.5'),(5,'5','2.5'),(12,'12','6'),(18,'18','9'),(28,'28','14'),(0.1,'0.10','0.05'),(40,'40','20')) r(rate,lbl,half)
CROSS APPLY (VALUES ('GST Purchase '+r.lbl+'%'),('GST Sales '+r.lbl+'%'),('IGST Purchase '+r.lbl+'%'),('IGST Sales '+r.lbl+'%'),('IGST Input '+r.lbl+'%'),('IGST Output '+r.lbl+'%'),('CGST Input '+r.half+'%'),('CGST Output '+r.half+'%'),('SGST Input '+r.half+'%'),('SGST Output '+r.half+'%')) l(lbl)

WHERE n.cnt<>1 OR n.bad>0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Exempt label '+l.lbl+CASE WHEN n.cnt=0 THEN ' has no account' WHEN n.cnt>1 THEN ' is on several accounts' ELSE ' account is a group or inactive' END, n.maxid
FROM (VALUES (N'Purchase '+NCHAR(8211)+N' Exempted'),(N'Sales '+NCHAR(8211)+N' Exempt')) l(lbl)
CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) cnt, MAX(a.Act_Id) maxid, SUM(CASE WHEN a.Act_Cat<>'A' OR ISNULL(a.Act_Usage,0)<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad FROM IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_TT=l.lbl) n

title: GST tax and rate-head accounts classified inconsistently (Input/Purchase heads typed Income)
why: The 2017-era GST accounts (5/12/18/28%, 3%, 1.5/2.5/6/9/14% halves) are all Act_Type 'Income' under Un-Grouped Incomes (MBM) / INCOMES (MP), so input-tax credit and purchase heads sit on the income side of the P&L and output tax is not shown as a liability. Accounts HQ generated later (0.05/0.10/20/40%) follow a different scheme: Purchase heads Expense, Input/Output 20%/40% Liability, Sales Income. Bills and GST returns are unaffected (they key on Act_TT); only financial statements are.
detectSql:
SELECT 'Account '+CAST(a.Act_Id AS varchar(12))+' '+RTRIM(a.Act_Name)+' is '+a.Act_Type+' (expected '+x.exp+' by the scheme HQ uses for newer rates)' Finding, a.Act_Id
FROM IQAccmst a CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN a.Act_TT LIKE '%GST Purchase%' THEN 'Expense' WHEN a.Act_TT LIKE '%GST Sales%' THEN 'Income' WHEN a.Act_TT LIKE '%GST Input%' OR a.Act_TT LIKE '%GST Output%' THEN 'Liability' END exp) x
WHERE a.Act_Cat='A' AND a.Act_TT LIKE '%GST %' AND x.exp IS NOT NULL AND a.Act_Type<>x.exp
advice: Owner/accountant question: 'Your GST input/output and purchase rate heads are classified as Income. Do you want them regrouped (input/output tax to Duties & Taxes liability, purchase heads to Purchase/Expense) so the P&L and balance sheet read correctly? This changes reports for all years, not bills or GST returns.' Not automatic: the target groups are the accountant's choice. Note the half-rate 'GST Input/Output r%' accounts (no CGST/SGST prefix) are not used by HQ's item rule at all.

title: Sibling transaction types disagree on tax-inclusive pricing

title: Bills whose ledger does not balance (not explained by round-off)
why: Debits and credits differ by more than the round-off effect: an output-tax account or the cash book is misstated. In 3 bills CGST was posted with the full tax and SGST with half (CGST Output overstated, books out by half the tax).

CS/323 and CS/326 differ from their lines by 0.02-0.05 of tax rounding. Repair: open each bill in HQ and save it unchanged (F10); HQ re-posts from the item grid. Equivalent: MK engine re-post (InvoiceLedger.Plan) in a locked write. Owner question: 'Re-save these 6 bills (Jun-Aug 2026)? The ledger changes only; GST lines and returns stay as filed.'

title: Ledger rows disagreeing with their header (date, series, number, party, amount, cash mode)
why: Ledger and bill registers would show different dates/numbers/amounts for the same bill; party ledgers would not match the invoice.
detectSql: SELECT 'Row '+CAST(d.SR_NO AS varchar(20))+' of '+RTRIM(h.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(h.TNo AS varchar(12))+' ('+CONVERT(varchar(10),h.Doc_Date,103)+')'+' has date/series/number/cash-contra different from the header' AS Finding, CAST(h.Doc_Id AS bigint) AS Doc_Id FROM dbo.IQDayBook d JOIN dbo.IQDoc_Header h ON h.Doc_Id=d.Doc_ID WHERE d.TRDATE<>h.Doc_Date OR ISNULL(RTRIM(d.Tseries),'')<>ISNULL(RTRIM(h.TSeries),'') OR ISNULL(d.Tno,-1)<>h.TNo OR (d.TYPE IN ('P','R') AND (ISNULL(d.Contra_ID,0)<>6 OR h.Mode<>0)) UNION ALL SELECT 'Party row of '+RTRIM(h.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(h.TNo AS varchar(12))+' ('+CONVERT(varchar(10),h.Doc_Date,103)+')'+' does not carry the bill amount' AS Finding, CAST(h.Doc_Id AS bigint) AS Doc_Id FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header h CROSS APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END) AS amt FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Doc_ID=h.Doc_Id AND d.Act_ID=h.HeadAct_ID) p WHERE h.Tt_Id IN (500,501,506,507) AND h.Mode<>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Doc_ID=h.Doc_Id) AND (p.n<>1 OR ABS(p.amt*CASE WHEN h.Tt_Id IN (500,501) THEN -1 ELSE 1 END - h.Bill_Amt)>0.005) UNION ALL SELECT 'Voucher '+RTRIM(h.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(h.TNo AS varchar(12))+' ('+CONVERT(varchar(10),h.Doc_Date,103)+')'+' header row or line total disagrees with the header' AS Finding, CAST(h.Doc_Id AS bigint) AS Doc_Id FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header h CROSS APPLY (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.LnNo=-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hdr, MAX(CASE WHEN d.LnNo=-1 THEN d.Act_ID END) AS hdrAct, SUM(CASE WHEN d.LnNo=-1 THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS hdrAmt, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(d.LnNo,0)<>-1 THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS lineAmt FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Doc_ID=h.Doc_Id) v WHERE h.Tt_Id BETWEEN 204 AND 209 AND v.lineAmt IS NOT NULL AND (ABS(v.lineAmt-h.Bill_Amt)>0.005 OR (h.Tt_Id NOT IN (204,206) AND (ISNULL(v.hdr,0)<>1 OR v.hdrAct<>h.Act_ID OR ABS(v.hdrAmt-h.Bill_Amt)>0.005)))
advice: None today in either firm (checked: TRDATE=Doc_Date, Tseries/Tno, HeadAct party row = Bill_Amt, voucher header row = Act_ID/Bill_Amt, P/R rows only in cash documents with contra 6). Any future hit: re-save the document in HQ.

title: Card/UPI/credit sales posted to 'Cash on hand'
why: Phone Pe sales whose bank account was chosen as Cash on hand, and credit sales to the Cash account, put money into cash-in-hand that went to the bank (or is owed by a customer). Cash book overstated, bank understated; no customer outstanding is tracked.
detectSql: SELECT 'Mode '+CAST(h.Mode AS varchar(3))+' sale posted to Cash on hand: '+RTRIM(h.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(h.TNo AS varchar(12))+' ('+CONVERT(varchar(10),h.Doc_Date,103)+')'+' '+CAST(h.Bill_Amt AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(h.Doc_Id AS bigint) AS Doc_Id, CAST(6 AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header h WHERE h.Tt_Id IN (500,501,506,507) AND h.Mode<>0 AND h.HeadAct_ID=6
advice: HQ does this when the operator picks Cash on hand as the payment account (FrmInwards.SaveDaybookActwise_Summary posts the party row on txtcode.Tag). Owner question per bill: 'Which account received this money (KARUR VYSYABANK 890, PHONE PAY, or a customer)?' Then re-open the bill in HQ, set that account and save. Not auto: the right account is a fact only the shop knows.

title: Bill-wise links (ADJUST) whose both ledger rows no longer exist
why: Left over from previous years (copied into the new year's database). Invisible in HQ reports, but they make settlement queries unreliable, and in MK Paints 42 of them carry SR_NOs above the current IQDayBook identity (next at 49253): when the ledger numbering reaches them, old settlements would silently attach to new bills and corrupt outstanding.
detectSql: SELECT 'Dead link '+CAST(a.Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' -> '+CAST(a.Rel_Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' amount '+CAST(a.Amount AS varchar(20)) AS Finding FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=a.Sr_No) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No)
fixSql: DELETE a FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=a.Sr_No) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No);
advice: Equivalent to HQ's DeleteBilltoBillAdjustment for these links: its counter updates hit no rows (both rows are gone) and it deletes the link. No IQDayBook row, balance or HQ report changes. Keep a copy of the deleted rows in the MK write journal (not in HQ's 'adjusted' table, which HQ's bill-wise dialog reads). Test (rolled back): mbm before=759 rowsAffected=759 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0; mp before=85 rowsAffected=85 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0.

title: Payments settled against an opening-balance row that was later re-created
why: The payment row still counts the amount as allocated (BL_adjusted) but its target row is gone, so the payment is neither open nor attached to anything. Meanwhile the re-created opening row shows as open and was in several cases settled again by later payments: bill-wise outstanding and ageing for these 13 parties are wrong.
detectSql: SELECT 'Link '+CAST(a.Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' -> '+CAST(a.Rel_Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' ('+CAST(a.Amount AS varchar(20))+'): '+CASE WHEN s.SR_NO IS NULL THEN 'source' ELSE 'target' END+' row missing; live side '+ISNULL(RTRIM(h.TSeries)+'/'+CAST(h.TNo AS varchar(12)),'opening')+' account '+CAST(l.Act_ID AS varchar(12)) AS Finding, CAST(l.Doc_ID AS bigint) AS Doc_Id, CAST(l.Act_ID AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.ADJUST a LEFT JOIN dbo.IQDayBook s ON s.SR_NO=a.Sr_No LEFT JOIN dbo.IQDayBook r ON r.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No JOIN dbo.IQDayBook l ON l.SR_NO=ISNULL(s.SR_NO,r.SR_NO) LEFT JOIN dbo.IQDoc_Header h ON h.Doc_Id=l.Doc_ID WHERE (s.SR_NO IS NULL AND r.SR_NO IS NOT NULL) OR (s.SR_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.SR_NO IS NULL)
advice: Root cause: on 8 Jun 2026 10:50 HQ's 'update opening balances from previous year' (FrmNewFy.cs:846-847 'Delete From IQDaybook Where doc_id=-1', then ClsNewFY re-inserts, ClsNewFY.cs:1437 for bill-wise accounts) deleted and re-inserted all 206 opening rows without touching ADJUST; accounts 10636/10970/10695 were re-created again on 11 Oct / 2 Nov the same way. HQ never repairs this. Two options, owner decides per party: (a) release (prepared SQL above, tested: clears all, BL check stays clean) = DeleteBilltoBillAdjustment semantics on the surviving row, the payment becomes on-account and is re-allocated in HQ's bill-wise screen; (b) re-point the link to the account's current opening row (HQ's own precedent: FrmInwards.cs:37823 'Update Adjust set Rel_SR_NO=new where Rel_SR_NO=old') - only possible where that row still has room (accounts 11059, 10209, 10218, 10695). Question: 'For SAAI KUMAR VALVES (4 payments, Rs 1,33,338) and SURYA AGENIES (BP/2 and BP/61 both settle the Rs 26,836 opening) etc., which bills did these payments really pay?'. Do not run while an HQ user is editing a bill: HQ's own edit passes through this state transiently. Prepared repair (owner approval required, tested rolled back: mbm before=19 rowsAffected=797 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0; mp before=0 rowsAffected=85 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0): UPDATE d SET d.BL_adjusted = ISNULL(d.BL_adjusted,0) - x.amt FROM dbo.IQDayBook d JOIN ( SELECT a.Sr_No AS sr, SUM(a.Amount) AS amt FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook t WHERE t.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No) GROUP BY a.Sr_No UNION ALL SELECT a.Rel_Sr_No, SUM(a.Amount) FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook t WHERE t.SR_NO=a.Sr_No) GROUP BY a.Rel_Sr_No) x ON x.sr=d.SR_NO; DELETE a FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook t WHERE t.SR_NO=a.Sr_No) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook t WHERE t.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No);

title: Bill-wise links that are duplicated, self-referencing, non-positive, cross-account or same-side
why: A link must join a debit and a credit of the same account; anything else corrupts outstanding and the BL_adjusted counters.
detectSql: SELECT 'Bad link '+CAST(a.Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' -> '+CAST(a.Rel_Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' amount '+CAST(a.Amount AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(s.Doc_ID AS bigint) AS Doc_Id, CAST(s.Act_ID AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.ADJUST a JOIN dbo.IQDayBook s ON s.SR_NO=a.Sr_No JOIN dbo.IQDayBook r ON r.SR_NO=a.Rel_Sr_No WHERE ISNULL(a.Amount,0)<=0 OR a.Sr_No=a.Rel_Sr_No OR s.Act_ID<>r.Act_ID OR (s.TYPE IN ('D','P') AND r.TYPE IN ('D','P')) OR (s.TYPE IN ('C','R') AND r.TYPE IN ('C','R')) OR (s.Doc_ID=r.Doc_ID AND s.Doc_ID<>-1) UNION ALL SELECT 'Duplicate link '+CAST(g.Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' -> '+CAST(g.Rel_Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' x'+CAST(g.c AS varchar(5)) AS Finding, NULL AS Doc_Id, NULL AS Act_Id FROM (SELECT Sr_No, Rel_Sr_No, COUNT(*) AS c FROM dbo.ADJUST GROUP BY Sr_No, Rel_Sr_No HAVING COUNT(*)>1) g
advice: None today. FrmBill2BillAdj only offers same-account, opposite-side open items, so a hit would mean an external write. Repair would be DeleteBilltoBillAdjustment on the source row and re-allocation in HQ.

title: BL_adjusted differs from the sum of its ADJUST links
why: HQ's outstanding and bill-wise screens use AMOUNT-BL_adjusted to decide what is open; a wrong counter shows paid bills as due (or the reverse).
detectSql: SELECT 'Row '+CAST(d.SR_NO AS varchar(20))+' BL_adjusted '+CAST(ISNULL(d.BL_adjusted,0) AS varchar(20))+' but links total '+CAST(ISNULL(l.s,0) AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(d.Doc_ID AS bigint) AS Doc_Id, CAST(d.Act_ID AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQDayBook d OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(a.Amount) AS s FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE a.Sr_No=d.SR_NO OR a.Rel_Sr_No=d.SR_NO) l WHERE ABS(ISNULL(d.BL_adjusted,0)-ISNULL(l.s,0))>0.005
fixSql: UPDATE d SET d.BL_adjusted = ISNULL(l.s,0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d OUTER APPLY (SELECT SUM(a.Amount) AS s FROM dbo.ADJUST a WHERE a.Sr_No=d.SR_NO OR a.Rel_Sr_No=d.SR_NO) l WHERE ABS(ISNULL(d.BL_adjusted,0)-ISNULL(l.s,0))>0.005;
advice: None today (269 settled rows in MBM all reconcile, including rows whose partner is missing). The invariant is the one HQ maintains: every ADJUST insert adds its amount to both rows and DeleteBilltoBillAdjustment subtracts it from both (spec hq-spec-voucher-modify.md 3-4). Recomputing restores exactly that state. Run only after ADJ-HALF is decided, and not during an HQ edit (HQ's edit releases and re-applies in separate autocommit steps). Test (rolled back): mbm before=1 (seeded corruption) rowsAffected=1 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0; mp before=1 (seeded corruption) rowsAffected=1 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0.

title: BL_adjusted negative or larger than the row amount
why: An over-allocated row means more was settled than billed; a negative counter means a release ran twice. Outstanding would show negative dues.
detectSql: SELECT 'Row '+CAST(d.SR_NO AS varchar(20))+' amount '+CAST(d.AMOUNT AS varchar(20))+' BL_adjusted '+CAST(d.BL_adjusted AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(d.Doc_ID AS bigint) AS Doc_Id, CAST(d.Act_ID AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.BL_adjusted<-0.005 OR d.BL_adjusted>d.AMOUNT+0.005
advice: None today. HQ's only guard is in the dialog (FrmBill2BillAdj.cs:957); a bill edited down below what was settled could produce this. Question: 'Which settlement should be reduced?'

title: Stale previous-year rows in HQ's 'adjusted' backup table
why: HQ backs up links into 'adjusted' while a voucher or bill is being edited and offers them again in the bill-wise dialog. Rows from previous years can never be matched (their SR_NOs are below this year's first ledger row) and only add noise.
detectSql: SELECT 'Stale backup '+CAST(x.Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' -> '+CAST(x.Rel_Sr_No AS varchar(20))+' amount '+CAST(x.Amount AS varchar(20)) AS Finding FROM dbo.adjusted x WHERE x.Sr_No < (SELECT MIN(SR_NO) FROM dbo.IQDayBook) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=x.Sr_No)
fixSql: DELETE x FROM dbo.adjusted x WHERE x.Sr_No < (SELECT MIN(SR_NO) FROM dbo.IQDayBook) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.SR_NO=x.Sr_No);
advice: Leaves the table as HQ's successful save path does (empty). Restricted to SR_NOs below this year's first ledger row on purpose: a backup whose row was just deleted by an HQ edit in progress (FrmFin_Vouchers step A / FrmInwards.cs:37785) also has a missing SR_NO and must not be touched. Test (rolled back): mbm before=16 rowsAffected=16 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0; mp before=6 rowsAffected=6 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0.

title: Account master shows an opening balance but no opening ledger row exists
why: HQ's ledgers and trial balance read opening balances only from IQDayBook Doc_ID=-1 rows and never from IQAccmst.Act_OPbal, so HQ shows these accounts as zero while MK's reports (ReportService.Opening counts the master figure when no row exists) show the master amount. The two systems disagree by these amounts.
detectSql: SELECT 'Master opening '+CAST(a.Act_OPbal AS varchar(20))+' '+ISNULL(a.Act_OpSign,'')+' without ledger row: '+LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Act_Name)) AS Finding, CAST(a.Act_Id AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQAccmst a WHERE a.Act_Cat='A' AND ISNULL(a.Act_OPbal,0)<>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook o WHERE o.Act_ID=a.Act_Id AND o.Doc_ID=-1)
advice: Opening the account in HQ and saving it loads the opening from the (absent) rows and writes Act_OPbal=0 plus a zero opening row (FrmAccounts.Save_Daybook, FrmAccounts.cs:10787) - HQ would erase the master figure. Owner question: 'Do MODERAN ELECTRIAL CENTER, Shri srinivasa polymers and the two HIRANYAMAYI PLASTICS accounts (49,200 Cr and 49,200 Dr - they cancel) really have these opening balances?' If no: re-save in HQ. If yes: enter the opening in HQ. Separately, MK's ReportService.Opening should ignore Act_OPbal to match HQ.

title: Opening ledger rows that disagree with the account master
why: Only account 8 'Profit & Loss - Previous Year': HQ's new-year routine inserts one opening row for the carried P&L balance and another for last year's profit, but the master keeps only the last figure. HQ reports use the rows, so nothing is wrong in HQ.
detectSql: SELECT 'Opening rows '+CAST(o.net AS varchar(20))+' vs master '+CAST(CASE WHEN a.Act_OpSign='C' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END*ISNULL(a.Act_OPbal,0) AS varchar(20))+' ('+CAST(o.n AS varchar(5))+' rows): '+LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Act_Name)) AS Finding, CAST(a.Act_Id AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQAccmst a JOIN (SELECT Act_ID, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN AMOUNT ELSE -AMOUNT END) AS net FROM dbo.IQDayBook WHERE Doc_ID=-1 GROUP BY Act_ID) o ON o.Act_ID=a.Act_Id WHERE a.Act_Id<>5 AND (o.n>1 OR ABS(o.net - CASE WHEN a.Act_OpSign='C' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END*ISNULL(a.Act_OPbal,0))>0.005)
advice: ClsNewFY.cs:390-412 writes the P&L rows and overwrites Act_OPbal of account 8. Leave as is; MK code must sum the rows (never use Act_OPbal when rows exist) - the current ReportService rule already does.

title: Account 5 'Opening Balance Difference' out of step with the opening rows
why: HQ keeps account 5 equal to the net of all other opening rows on every account save (FrmAccounts.UpdateOpeningBalanceDifferenceAccount, FrmAccounts.cs:9746). If it drifts the opening trial balance no longer balances.
detectSql: SELECT 'Account 5 holds '+ISNULL(o.typ,'-')+' '+CAST(ISNULL(o.amt,0) AS varchar(20))+' / master '+ISNULL(m.Act_OpSign,'')+' '+CAST(ISNULL(m.Act_OPbal,0) AS varchar(20))+' but opening rows need '+CASE WHEN n.net>0 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END+' '+CAST(ABS(n.net) AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(5 AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM (SELECT (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE (-1)*d.AMOUNT END),0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d INNER JOIN dbo.IQAccMst a ON d.Act_ID=a.Act_ID WHERE d.TYPE IN ('D','d','C','c') AND a.Act_ID<>5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1) AS net) n CROSS JOIN dbo.IQAccmst m OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, MAX(d.TYPE) AS typ, MAX(d.AMOUNT) AS amt, MIN(d.Doc_ID) AS doc FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Act_ID=5) o WHERE m.Act_Id=5 AND (o.c<>1 OR o.doc<>-1 OR ABS(ISNULL(o.amt,0)-ABS(n.net))>0.005 OR ISNULL(o.typ,'')<>CASE WHEN n.net>0 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END OR ABS(ISNULL(m.Act_OPbal,0)-ABS(n.net))>0.005 OR ISNULL(m.Act_OpSign,'')<>CASE WHEN n.net>0 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END)
fixSql: UPDATE dbo.IQAccMst SET Act_Opbal=CAST(ABS((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE (-1)*d.AMOUNT END),0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d INNER JOIN dbo.IQAccMst a ON d.Act_ID=a.Act_ID WHERE d.TYPE IN ('D','d','C','c') AND a.Act_ID<>5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1)) AS decimal(18,2)), Act_opSign=CASE WHEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE (-1)*d.AMOUNT END),0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d INNER JOIN dbo.IQAccMst a ON d.Act_ID=a.Act_ID WHERE d.TYPE IN ('D','d','C','c') AND a.Act_ID<>5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1) > 0 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END WHERE Act_Id=5; UPDATE dbo.IQDayBook SET AMOUNT=CAST(ABS((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE (-1)*d.AMOUNT END),0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d INNER JOIN dbo.IQAccMst a ON d.Act_ID=a.Act_ID WHERE d.TYPE IN ('D','d','C','c') AND a.Act_ID<>5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1)) AS decimal(18,2)), TYPE=CASE WHEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','d') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE (-1)*d.AMOUNT END),0) FROM dbo.IQDayBook d INNER JOIN dbo.IQAccMst a ON d.Act_ID=a.Act_ID WHERE d.TYPE IN ('D','d','C','c') AND a.Act_ID<>5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1) > 0 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END WHERE Act_ID=5 AND Doc_ID=-1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.IQDayBook z WHERE z.Act_ID=5)=1;
advice: Clean in both firms. The repair writes the same amount and side HQ computes; HQ itself deletes and re-inserts the account-5 row (new SR_NO, Ent_Date) - the in-place update differs only in that identity, which nothing references. If account 5 has 0 or several rows the update is skipped: then re-save any account in HQ. Test (rolled back): mbm before=1 (seeded corruption) rowsAffected=2 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0; mp before=1 (seeded corruption) rowsAffected=2 after=0 blViolationsAfter=0.

title: Opening trial balance does not balance (difference parked in account 5)
why: The previous-year closing balances carried in do not net to zero; HQ parks the difference in 'Opening Balance Difference'. The balance sheet carries an unexplained amount (MBM Rs 21.8 lakh Cr, MP Rs 7.5 lakh Dr).
detectSql: SELECT 'Opening difference '+d.TYPE+' '+CAST(d.AMOUNT AS varchar(20)) AS Finding, CAST(5 AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Act_ID=5 AND d.Doc_ID=-1 AND ABS(d.AMOUNT)>0.005
advice: An accounting question for the accountant (previous-year books), not a data repair. Not to be changed by MK.

title: Days with negative cash in hand
why: Cash cannot go below zero; a negative running balance means a cash receipt is missing or a payment is wrongly in cash.
detectSql: SELECT 'Cash in hand '+CAST(CAST(b.bal AS decimal(19,2)) AS varchar(30))+' on '+CONVERT(varchar(10),b.TRDATE,103) AS Finding, CAST(6 AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM (SELECT c.TRDATE, SUM(c.mv) OVER (ORDER BY c.TRDATE ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS bal FROM (SELECT d.TRDATE, SUM(CASE WHEN d.Act_ID=6 THEN CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END ELSE CASE WHEN d.TYPE='R' THEN d.AMOUNT WHEN d.TYPE='P' THEN -d.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END END) AS mv FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Act_ID=6 OR (d.Contra_ID=6 AND d.Act_ID<>6 AND d.TYPE IN ('P','R')) GROUP BY d.TRDATE) c) b WHERE b.bal < -0.005
advice: None in either firm (cash never goes negative; see CASH-BANK-RECON for the opposite problem). Cash = account 6 rows plus P/R rows whose implicit contra is cash, as ReportService does.

title: Cash and bank books not reconciled (no contra entries)
why: Cash in hand keeps growing (MBM Rs 1.72 crore, MP Rs 92 lakh) while the main bank account is overdrawn in the books (MBM KVB 890 -Rs 1.12 crore, MP KVB -Rs 3.98 lakh). No cash-deposit/withdrawal (contra) voucher exists this year, so cash banked is never moved out of cash.
detectSql: SELECT 'Bank account overdrawn in books: '+LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Act_Name))+' '+CAST(b.bal AS varchar(30)) AS Finding, CAST(a.Act_Id AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM dbo.IQAccmst a JOIN (SELECT d.Act_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END) AS bal FROM dbo.IQDayBook d GROUP BY d.Act_ID) b ON b.Act_ID=a.Act_Id WHERE a.Act_Type='Bank' AND b.bal < -0.005 UNION ALL SELECT 'No cash/bank contra voucher this year; cash in hand '+CAST(c.bal AS varchar(30)) AS Finding, CAST(6 AS bigint) AS Act_Id FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.Act_ID=6 THEN CASE WHEN d.TYPE IN ('D','P') THEN d.AMOUNT ELSE -d.AMOUNT END ELSE CASE WHEN d.TYPE='R' THEN d.AMOUNT WHEN d.TYPE='P' THEN -d.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END END) AS bal FROM dbo.IQDayBook d WHERE d.Act_ID=6 OR (d.Contra_ID=6 AND d.Act_ID<>6 AND d.TYPE IN ('P','R'))) c WHERE c.bal > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDayBook d JOIN dbo.IQDoc_Header h ON h.Doc_Id=d.Doc_ID JOIN dbo.IQAccmst x ON x.Act_Id=d.Act_ID WHERE h.Tt_Id BETWEEN 204 AND 207 AND x.Act_Type IN ('Cash','Bank') AND ISNULL(d.LnNo,0)<>-1)
advice: Owner question: 'Are cash deposits into the bank (and withdrawals) entered anywhere? Should we start recording them as contra vouchers, and will the accountant reconcile the bank book with the statement?' Nothing to repair automatically.

title: Charge master created by the MK prototype in use on HQ bills
why: 'MK Core Round purchase f0e57d9e' (type Add) was created by the old TypeScript prototype and sits in HQ's purchase charge set; HQ operators now use it as the purchase round-off. It posts correctly (Add rule), but it is a machine-named master in live data.
detectSql: SELECT 'Charge '+RTRIM(c.Chrg_Name)+' ('+CAST(c.Chrg_Id AS varchar(6))+') used on '+CAST(COUNT(*) AS varchar(10))+' bills' AS Finding FROM dbo.IQCHARGES c JOIN dbo.IQDoc_Chrgs dc ON dc.Chrg_id=c.Chrg_Id WHERE c.Chrg_Name LIKE 'MK Core%' GROUP BY c.Chrg_Id, c.Chrg_Name
advice: Do not delete (bills reference it). Owner may rename it to 'Round Off (Purchase)' in HQ. Recorded so MK's parity logic knows it is a legitimate Add-type round-off.

title: Credit purchases recorded but no payment vouchers this year
why: MK Paints has 59 credit purchases (Rs 6.0 lakh) and no payment voucher at all in FY 2026-27, so every supplier balance only grows; payables are overstated unless payments are entered.
detectSql: SELECT 'Credit purchases '+CAST(p.amt AS varchar(20))+' in '+CAST(p.n AS varchar(10))+' bills but no payment vouchers' AS Finding FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(h.Bill_Amt) AS amt FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header h WHERE h.Tt_Id IN (500,501) AND h.Mode=1) p WHERE p.n>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.IQDoc_Header v WHERE v.Tt_Id IN (206,207))
advice: Owner question: 'Are MK Paints supplier payments made from another firm's account or simply not entered?'
